scope: 16 representative interior/startup sheets; selected callouts only

records.title: コクピット (1)
records.obs: Bridge cutaway with seat/console cluster, rear doorway, monitor surface, overhead Gilliam indicator, circular floor emergency hatch.
calls: エマージェンシー・ハッチ
アウトロースター号内の各セクションの床から天井までの高さは２メートル位です。
Floor-to-ceiling height in each section inside the Outlaw Star is approximately 2 metres.
records.questions: Does the ~2 m convention apply to every depicted section/step level? Check animation and reconcile machinery/platform clearance before treating it as a uniform deck height.

records.title: コクピット (3) フィジカル ナビゲーション システム 作動時
records.en: Cockpit (3): physical navigation system in operation
records.obs: Navigation control cylinder raised behind seat cluster; view pairs with closed-state bridge drawing.
calls: メルフィナのコントロール・シリンダー 作動時
records.questions: Top view number (3) versus inset (2) differs. Preserve both; raised-state motion clearance remains unmeasured.

records.title: コクピット (4) フィジカル ナビゲーション システム 解説
records.obs: Numbered diagrams show hatch opening, occupant platform descent, hatch closure, cylinder rise, and lateral shields opening. Character used for scale.
calls: メルフィナが乗ると下がりはじめます。（エレベーターみたいなもの）
When Melfina gets on, it starts descending (like an elevator).
シリンダー スライドUPする。
シールドが左右にスライドして完了。
Shields slide left/right to complete the sequence.
records.questions: Fluid appearance, sealing interlocks, stroke, and timing require anime comparison. The sheet doesn't assign a reactor/power dependency.

records.title: コクピット (2)
records.obs: Reverse bridge view with cylinder closed/stowed at floor; maintenance robot rail and Gilliam indicator labeled.
calls: メンテナンス・ロボのガイド・レール
メルフィナのコントロール・シリンダー クローズ時
records.questions: Top (2) versus inset (3) mismatch. Rail route past doorway is not fully drawn.

records.title: コクピット (6) グラップラー・アーム・コントローラー
records.obs: Seat-side control sections articulate/open to expose machinery and control grips; animation notes permit motion to follow character action.
calls: スリットは８本になります。
グラップラー・アームのコントロール・グリップ
バスの自動ドア開閉システムと同じものです。
Same as a bus automatic-door opening/closing system.
records.questions: Analogy describes linkage presentation, not a complete actuator specification. Don't impose a precise rigid-body mechanism without testing geometry.

records.title: コクピット (5) コンソール
records.obs: Gene's station includes wheel-like controls, grips, analog-style gauges, switches and a separate system activation key drawing.
records.questions: 8.5 cm applies to the comparison prop, not console dimensions. Station roles and key prerequisites require episode evidence.

records.title: 機関室 (2) 作動時
records.obs: Four circular assemblies in 2x2 bank; lower-left control cylinder extends into service space with gauges/buttons. Central paired circular access/control features and piping visible.
calls: 機関コントロール・シリンダー
records.questions: This drawing names a control cylinder; it does not prove the whole exterior engine moves. Confirm actual moving parts in Episode 4.

records.title: 機関室 (1)
records.obs: Same bank with four circular faces retracted/closed, service platform, Gilliam indicator and overhead robot rail.
calls: メンテナンス・ロボのガイド・レールあり。
records.questions: Direction label gives a connection toward dining room, not corridor length or aft coordinates.

records.title: 内部通路 (1) 食堂側から見た図
records.en: Interior passage (1), viewed from dining-room side
records.obs: View toward cockpit doorway; round exterior-access floor hatch, wall service hatch/control box, overhead rail and air conditioner.
calls: 外部へのアクセス・ハッチ
このラインが通路の中央になります。
This line is the centre of the passage.
records.questions: Do not equate round exterior-access hatch with rectangular airlock without evidence. Wall service hatch destination remains unknown.

records.title: 内部通路 (2) コクピット側から見た図
records.en: Interior passage (2), viewed from cockpit side
records.obs: Complementary view toward dining; overhead access ladder to Assault Tube and same exterior floor-access hatch are labeled.
calls: アサルト・チューブへのアクセス・ラダー
records.questions: Assault Tube versus Assault Shooter terminology needs cross-reference. Complementary drawings are not sufficient for full port/starboard handedness.

records.title: エアロック
records.inset: エア・ロックのハッチ
records.obs: External hatch framing with character scale reference, position marker and recessed control panel/light; lower annotation marks hull-bottom line.
calls: カバーは下へスライド
エア・ロックのハッチは一度奥までこめてからスライド
Airlock hatch first moves inward, then slides.
records.questions: Handwritten hatch-motion wording is a provisional reading. Drawing has episode/cut references (#4 C-35 / C-165); these are production cuts, not playback timestamps.

records.title: レストルーム ①
records.obs: Cabinet/bench wall, monitor, Gilliam indicator, four floor panels and rectangular door; cockpit direction arrow.
calls: 床面の４枚のパネルを上下させて、机やベッドにします。
Raise/lower the four floor panels to make a desk/table or bed.
records.questions: This is lounge/rest-space evidence, not proof of a toilet. Is it also the dining room? Needs episode matching.

records.title: レストルーム ②
records.obs: Companion view with four-panel furniture raised and cockpit direction marker.
calls: この面は実際には見えません。
This face is not actually visible.
records.questions: Visible cutaway face is explanatory artwork, not an exposed cabinet/wall to model literally. Full motion and furniture height unmeasured.

records.title: アサルト・シューター
records.inset: アサルト・シューター; handwritten alternate label unresolved
records.obs: Telescoping dorsal tube and capsule/occupant silhouette; hatch opens and seat turns downward; drill-like nose and exhaust drawn.
calls: クラッシュ・ブレードは三層構造です。（中央にカメラあります。）
Crash blade has a three-layer structure (camera in the centre).
records.questions: Capsule pressure-related adjective and inset alternate wording need closer transcription. No fixed deployed length supplied; do not turn this into an ordinary corridor automatically.

records.title: エアロック 内部
records.obs: Opposing hatch views, labelled space/bow directions, pressure-display animation stages, hatch slide arrow and grappler relationship note.
calls: エア・ロックのハッチの両わきには、グラップラー・アームがあります。
Grappler arms are on both sides of the airlock hatch.
records.questions: Initial display shorthand and compositing guidance are not expanded. Hatch view has a slide arrow; final mechanical trajectory needs comparison to SET-047.

records.title: レスト・ルーム（大ラフ）
records.obs: Preliminary galley-like room with stools/table, cabinets and monitors. Different from final July lounge pair.
records.questions: Do not combine preliminary stool/table geometry with approved-looking July floor-panel mechanism. Remaining rough handwritten labels not transcribed.
